# logo-gen

> A local web app for making logo marks and app icons with image models. A chat model writes a few distinct prompt directions from a brief, and image models render them: cloud models through OpenRouter, or local diffusion models on your own GPU. It runs on your machine with a web UI and a JSON HTTP API on `http://127.0.0.1:7860`.

Start it from the project folder. The first run sets up `uv`, `.venv` and the frontend (about a minute); later runs take a few seconds. It prints the URL when it's ready:

```sh
./launch.sh                 # macOS, Linux, Git Bash
.\launch.cmd                # Windows cmd or PowerShell
npm start -- --port 8000    # either, through Node or Bun
```

Options: `--port 7860`, `--host 0.0.0.0` to listen beyond localhost, `--with-local` to install local model support (PyTorch) up front, `--dev` for the Vite dev server.

Config and keys:

- The OpenRouter key is `OPENROUTER_KEY` in `.env` in the project folder (git ignores it). Set it in the UI under Settings, or with `PUT /api/secrets` and `{"name": "OPENROUTER_KEY", "value": "..."}`, which checks the key with OpenRouter before saving. A Hugging Face token for gated local models is `HF_TOKEN` the same way. Never print, log or commit either value; `GET /api/settings` only reports whether each is set.
- Settings live in `data/settings.json`. Read them with `GET /api/settings` and change any subset with `PUT /api/settings` (for example `{"image_models": ["recraft/recraft-v4.1-flash"], "images_per_prompt": 2}`).
- The library (images, chats, spend) is `data/library.sqlite3`. Images are files under `output/`, served at `/api/files/<path>`; add `?download=1` to download.

The quickest way to get images, then poll the job:

```sh
# brief in, directions written by the chat model, images rendered by the selected models
curl -s -X POST localhost:7860/api/generate/quick -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"brief": "An icon for a small Python geometry library", "count": 2}'
# -> {"id": "4f1c...", "status": "running", ...}

curl -s localhost:7860/api/jobs/4f1c...
# -> {"status": "done", "image_ids": ["a1b2...", ...], "cost": 0.014, "errors": [], ...}

curl -s 'localhost:7860/api/images?ids=a1b2...,c3d4...'   # each has "url", "prompt", "model", "cost"
```

Every long operation is a job: `POST` returns the job, then poll `GET /api/jobs/<id>` about once a second until `status` is `done`, `error` or `cancelled`. `image_ids` fills in while it runs. `POST /api/jobs/<id>/cancel` stops it. `GET /api/jobs` lists recent jobs.

Other calls you'll need:

- Your own prompts: `POST /api/generate` with `{"prompts": [{"prompt": "...", "concept": "short name", "style": ""}], "models": ["recraft/recraft-v4.1-flash"], "images_per_prompt": 2}`. Leave `models` out to use the ones in settings.
- Variations of an image: `POST /api/images/<id>/variations` with `{"count": 4, "mode": "remix"}` (new prompts close to the original) or `"reroll"` (same prompt, new seeds). It's a job.
- Upscale: `POST /api/images/<id>/upscale` with `{"method": "lanczos", "scale": 2}`. Methods: `lanczos` (fast, CPU), `realesrgan-anime` and `realesrgan-general` (need local model support; minutes per image on a CPU). Returns the new image right away, not a job.
- Remove the background: `POST /api/images/<id>/remove-background` with `{"method": "ai"}` (rembg, CPU is fine) or `{"method": "color", "tolerance": 30}` (keys out the corner color). Returns the new image.
- Upscales and background removals are kept as children of the original. `PUT /api/images/<id>/primary` with `{"child_id": "..."}` marks the version to use.
- Models: `GET /api/openrouter/models` (the live catalog with prices, cached 10 minutes), `GET /api/models/rankings` (quality, value and popularity per image model), `GET /api/local-models`.
- Local models: `POST /api/local-models/<id>/install` (download with progress in `GET /api/local-models`), `/cancel`, `DELETE /api/local-models/<id>`, and `POST /api/local-models/<id>/calibrate` for a speed test (a job). Use a local model as `local/<id>`, for example `local/zimage-turbo`.
- The designer chat: `POST /api/chats`, then `POST /api/chats/<id>/messages` with `{"content": "..."}`. The reply runs on the server; follow it with `GET /api/chats/<id>/messages/<reply_id>/stream` (server-sent events) or poll `GET /api/chats/<id>` until no message has `status` `streaming`. Directions it proposes are in that message's `prompts`.

Spend and caps:

- Every OpenRouter call is recorded from the `usage` OpenRouter returns. `GET /api/spend` is the total, `GET /api/spend?chat_id=<id>` one chat, and each job has `cost` (OpenRouter credits) and `byok` (billed to the user's own provider key through OpenRouter). Local images cost $0.
- Caps on images per model per request: `max_images_cloud` (default 8), `max_images_local` (16) and `model_caps` per model id, in settings. The server trims requests over the cap and says so in the job's `notes`.
- Cloud images cost real money, from under a cent to about $0.30 each. Check `price_per_image` in the catalog before asking for many, and ask your user before spending more than they agreed to.

Local model hardware (an NVIDIA GPU unless noted; `GET /api/system` says what this machine has):

| id | Download | VRAM | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `zimage-turbo` | 6.8 GB | about 6 GB | NVIDIA only. About 30 s per 1024px image on an RTX 3080. |
| `flux2-klein-4b` | 16 GB | about 8 GB | NVIDIA, Apple Silicon (slow). |
| `flux1-schnell` | 34 GB | about 10 GB | NVIDIA only. Gated on Hugging Face. |
| `sd-turbo` | 2.6 GB | about 3 GB | The only one that runs on a CPU, slowly. 512px. |

Gotchas:

- The server listens on 127.0.0.1 only. Don't add `--host 0.0.0.0` unless your user asks: the API has no authentication and can spend their OpenRouter credits.
- If 7860 is taken, it uses the next free port and prints it. Read the printed URL instead of assuming the port.
- The first local model install also installs PyTorch and diffusers into `.venv` (about 2.5 GB for CUDA builds) before the model itself. Cloud-only use never downloads them.
- Gated models (FLUX.1 schnell) need the license accepted on Hugging Face by the token's owner and `HF_TOKEN` set. `POST /api/local-models/<id>/check-access` says whether that's done. You can't accept the license for them.
- Without a GPU, or with `LOGO_GEN_DEVICE=cpu`, local generation is limited to SD-Turbo. Everything else works: OpenRouter, the library, background removal and Lanczos upscaling.
- OpenRouter errors come back with a `kind`: `bad_key`, `credits`, `key_limit`, `rate_limit` (with `retry_after`) or `unavailable`.

If you're an AI agent and you hit a bug or something missing in logo-gen, tell your user and offer to open an issue or a pull request. Don't open one without their go-ahead. AGENTS.md has the details for working on the code.

## HTTP API reference

Generated by `scripts/llms.py` from the server's OpenAPI schema. Everything is JSON under
`http://127.0.0.1:7860/api` unless noted. Errors come back as `{"error": "...", "kind": "..."}`
or FastAPI's `{"detail": ...}`, with a 4xx or 5xx status.

### GET /api/health

Liveness check: {"ok": true}.

### GET /api/system

This machine: OS, device (cuda, mps or cpu), GPU and VRAM, free disk, and library totals.

### GET /api/settings

Current settings, plus which secrets are set (never their values).

### PUT /api/settings

Change any subset of settings, e.g. {"image_models": [...], "images_per_prompt": 2}. Returns the full settings.

Body (object):

### POST /api/settings/reset

### PUT /api/secrets

Set or clear OPENROUTER_KEY or HF_TOKEN in .env. An OpenRouter key is checked with OpenRouter first.

Body (SecretIn):
  - `name`: str
  - `value`: str = ''

### GET /api/openrouter/key

Whether the saved OpenRouter key works, what it has spent and its limit.

### GET /api/openrouter/models

The live OpenRouter catalog, split into chat and image models, with prices and capabilities. Cached 10
minutes; force=true refetches.

Query:
  - `force`: bool = False

### GET /api/models/rankings

Quality (LMArena), value and popularity (OpenRouter usage) for every image model we can use.

Query:
  - `refresh`: bool = False

### GET /api/llm/local

### GET /api/llm/claude-cli

### GET /api/local-models

Local models with install state, download progress, device support, batch size and caps.

### GET /api/local-stack

### POST /api/local-stack/install

### POST /api/local-models/{model_id}/calibrate

Speed test for a local model: times batch sizes and peak VRAM. Returns a job; its result has the options.

### POST /api/local-models/{model_id}/install

Start or resume downloading a local model. Progress shows in GET /api/local-models.

### POST /api/local-models/{model_id}/cancel

Pause a download. Installing again resumes it.

### DELETE /api/local-models/{model_id}

Delete a local model's files.

### POST /api/local-models/{model_id}/check-access

For gated models: whether HF_TOKEN can download it.

### GET /api/jobs

Recent jobs, newest first.

### GET /api/jobs/{job_id}

One job: status (running, done, error, cancelled), done/total, message, image_ids, cost, byok, notes, errors.

### POST /api/jobs/{job_id}/cancel

Cancel a running job.

### POST /api/generate

Render your own prompts with the given (or default) image models. Returns a job.

Body (GenerateIn):
  - `prompts`: list[PromptIn]
  - `models`: list[str] | null (optional)
  - `images_per_prompt`: int | null (optional)
  - `references`: list[str] (optional)
  - `chat_id`: str | null (optional)
  - `message_id`: int | null (optional)
  - PromptIn:
    - `prompt`: str
    - `concept`: str = ''
    - `style`: str = ''

### POST /api/generate/quick

Brief in: the chat model writes `count` directions, then each is rendered. Returns a job.

Body (QuickIn):
  - `brief`: str
  - `count`: int | null (optional)
  - `enhance`: bool = True
  - `models`: list[str] | null (optional)
  - `images_per_prompt`: int | null (optional)
  - `references`: list[str] (optional)

### POST /api/images/{image_id}/variations

New images close to this one (mode remix writes new prompts; reroll keeps the prompt with new seeds). Returns a job.

Body (VariationIn):
  - `count`: int = 4
  - `mode`: str = 'remix'
  - `instruction`: str = ''
  - `model`: str | null (optional)

### GET /api/chats

Designer chats with at least one message, newest activity first, with spend and a thumbnail. q searches titles and messages.

Query:
  - `q`: str | null

### POST /api/chats

An empty chat.

Body (ChatIn):
  - `title`: str | null (optional)
  - `pinned`: bool | null (optional)

### GET /api/designer/last

The chat the designer had open last, from any browser.

### GET /api/chats/{chat_id}

A chat with the visible branch of messages (each with siblings, cost, status and the images made from it), its
jobs, spend, and the id of a reply that's still running.

### PATCH /api/chats/{chat_id}

Rename or pin a chat.

Body (ChatIn):
  - `title`: str | null (optional)
  - `pinned`: bool | null (optional)

### DELETE /api/chats/{chat_id}

Delete a chat (soft: POST .../restore undoes it for a week).

### POST /api/chats/{chat_id}/open

Remember this as the chat the designer opens next time.

### POST /api/chats/{chat_id}/restore

Undo a chat delete.

### POST /api/chats/{chat_id}/messages

Add a user message and start the designer's reply on the server. Returns user_id and reply_id; follow the
reply with the stream endpoint or by polling the chat. edit_of=<message id> sends an edited copy of that
message as a new branch.

Body (MessageIn):
  - `content`: str
  - `images`: list[str] (optional)
  - `parent_id`: int | null (optional)
  - `edit_of`: int | null (optional)

### POST /api/chats/{chat_id}/messages/{message_id}/regenerate

A new reply to the same user message. The old reply stays as a sibling.

### POST /api/chats/{chat_id}/messages/{message_id}/stop

### GET /api/chats/{chat_id}/messages/{message_id}/stream

SSE for one reply. Resumes after `after` or the Last-Event-ID header; otherwise starts with a snapshot.

Query:
  - `after`: int | null

### PUT /api/chats/{chat_id}/active

Show another branch: the given message and the newest replies below it.

Body (ActiveIn):
  - `message_id`: int

### DELETE /api/chats/{chat_id}/messages/{message_id}

Delete a message and everything after it. Returns a stamp to undo with.

### POST /api/chats/{chat_id}/messages/{message_id}/restore

Body (RestoreIn):
  - `stamp`: float

### POST /api/feedback

Record a reaction to an image: like, dislike, unrate (clear the rating) or pick ("use this direction").

Body (FeedbackIn):
  - `kind`: str
  - `image_id`: str | null (optional)
  - `chat_id`: str | null (optional)
  - `message_id`: int | null (optional)
  - `data`: object (optional)

### GET /api/feedback

Query:
  - `since_id`: int = 0
  - `chat_id`: str | null
  - `limit`: int = 500

### GET /api/images

Library images, newest first. Filter by kind (generated, upscaled, cleaned), favorite, q (text search),
chat_id, job_id or ids (comma separated).

Query:
  - `kind`: str | null
  - `favorite`: bool = False
  - `q`: str | null
  - `chat_id`: str | null
  - `job_id`: str | null
  - `ids`: str | null
  - `limit`: int = 200
  - `offset`: int = 0

### GET /api/images/{image_id}

One image with its parent and children (upscales, cleaned copies, variations).

### PATCH /api/images/{image_id}

Set favorite or note.

Body (ImagePatch):
  - `favorite`: bool | null (optional)
  - `note`: str | null (optional)

### DELETE /api/images/{image_id}

Delete an image, its file and its children.

### PUT /api/images/{image_id}/primary

Mark an upscaled or cleaned child as the version to use (child_id null clears it).

Body (PrimaryIn):
  - `child_id`: str | null (optional)

### GET /api/spend

What has been spent: OpenRouter credits, BYOK, by kind, image counts. Optionally for one chat.

Query:
  - `chat_id`: str | null

### GET /api/tools

Upscale methods and scales, and background removal models, available on this machine.

### POST /api/images/{image_id}/upscale

Upscale an image (methods from GET /api/tools). Returns the new image, kept as a child of the original.

Body (UpscaleIn):
  - `method`: str = 'realesrgan-anime'
  - `scale`: int = 4

### POST /api/images/{image_id}/remove-background

Remove the background with an AI model (method ai) or by keying out a color (method color). Returns the new image as a child.

Body (BackgroundIn):
  - `method`: str = 'ai'
  - `model`: str = 'isnet-general-use'
  - `alpha_matting`: bool = False
  - `erode_pixels`: int = 0
  - `tolerance`: int = 30
  - `color`: str | null (optional)

### POST /api/uploads

Upload reference images. Returns their paths for the references or images fields.

Body: multipart form data (`images`: one or more image files).

### GET /api/files/{rel}

Query:
  - `download`: bool = False
